discovered_issues.title: Phase 1 extractor: array callable permission_callbacks not resolved to guard entries
discovered_issues.root_cause_analysis: All 16 REST EPs in backwpup have permission_callback=__array_callable__ (Phase 1 extractor placeholder — couldn't resolve [$object, 'method'] syntax to a named function). As a result, 0 guards are emitted for these EPs in the IR. When _check_guard_consistency() runs, guards_by_ep.get(ep_id, []) returns [] → no nonce/cap guard detected → guard_score=0.1 → guard_contradiction issue added → confidence drops below PLAUSIBLE threshold → all 22 backwpup TP-claimed findings remain UNCERTAIN. Gate logic is correct given IR data. Fix location: Phase 1 extractor (function resolving permission_callback arrays to callable names). Scope: REST route extractor.
discovered_issues.severity: BLOCKER — prevents any backwpup findings from reaching CONFIRMED/PLAUSIBLE
affects: backwpup REST EPs (16 EPs, all 22 TP findings)
discovered_issues.guard_consistent_patch: DO NOT PATCH guard_consistent check — logic is correct. Fix the Phase 1 extractor instead.

discovered_issues.title: LLM review markdown contract: LLM uses **Type:** bold instead of - Type: bullet format
discovered_issues.root_cause_analysis: phase3_llm_review.py validate_markdown() expects '- Type:' bullet format (regex: r'^\s*[-*]\s*Type\s*:'). LLM outputs '**Type:**' bold format. Contract fails with rc=1. However, review JSON is fully populated (parser reads from JSON, not markdown). Impact: markdown validation fails but review data is not lost.
discovered_issues.severity: LOW — markdown fails but review JSON is correct and applied
discovered_issues.workaround: Review JSON is parsed independently of markdown. phase3_apply_review.py reads JSON, not markdown. No data loss.
